causes.label: demand
causes.quote: Demand was 730 MW higher than forecast 4 hours ahead and 400 MW higher than forecast half an hour ahead.

causes.label: scheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: There was around 2,400 MW of baseload generation on both planned and unplanned long-term outages, a majority of which is usually offered below $5,000/MWh.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: There was around 2,400 MW of baseload generation on both planned and unplanned long-term outages, a majority of which is usually offered below $5,000/MWh.

causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: Planned maintenance work on a transmission line in southern New South Wales and upgrades on the Queensland to New South Wales interconnector (QNI) meant New South Wales had limited access to lower priced generation from neighbouring regions and from southern New South Wales.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: Origin rebid 570 MW of capacity at Eraring power station to the price cap. This rebid was placed in error and contributed to the price exceeding $5,000/MWh.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: Line outages for the upgrade of QNI also limited exports from Queensland into New South Wales. This meant that the combined limits and flows into New South Wales from Queensland were around 600 MW lower than their nominal limits on QNI and Terranora.

constraints_named.quote: To manage the outage, AEMO invoked a constraint (discussed in the next section) affecting generation in southern New South Wales and flows on the Vic-NSW interconnector.

interconnectors_named.name: QNI
interconnectors_named.quote: Line outages for the upgrade of QNI also limited exports from Queensland into New South Wales.

interconnectors_named.name: Terranora
interconnectors_named.quote: This meant that the combined limits and flows into New South Wales from Queensland were around 600 MW lower than their nominal limits on QNI and Terranora.

interconnectors_named.name: Vic-NSW
interconnectors_named.quote: At 2.05 pm, demand increased by 175 MW, imports from Victoria increased by 59 MW to 532 MW and the constraint managing the outage bound.

intervals.quote: The dispatch price was close to or at the market cap price of $15,000/MWh for the 2.15 pm, 2.20 pm and 2.25 pm dispatch intervals.
